spans.s:
(इ) r. 1st cl. (शिङ्खति)
To go, to move or approach.

f. (-खा)
1 Point, top in general.
2 A crest.
3 A peacock's crest.
4 A lock of hair on the crown of the head.
5

Flame.
6

A radicating branch.
7 Any branch.
8 A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya.
9 Chief, principal.
10 Fever, proceeding from libidinous excitement or love.
11 A ray of light.
E.
शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. ख, and the vowel made short.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 The tail of a peacock.
2 Locks left on the crown or the sides of the head, at the period of tonsure in children: see the next.
E.
शिखिन् a peacock or any crested object, अम to be or belong to, ड aff., and the form irr.

m. (-कः)
Locks of hair left at the time of tonsure; three or five locks left in children in general, or especially those of the military class, in which latter case, the hair is left in a semicircular patch on each side of the head, covering rather more than the temporal bones, and following much the same outline: see काकपक्ष.
2 The crest or lock of hair left on the crown of the head.
3 A peacock's tail.
E.
शिखा a crest, अण्ड an egg, and कन् pleonasm, or aff. of comparison; also शिखाण्डक and शिखण्ड.

(-कः)
Hair left on each side of the head: see शिखण्डक.

m. (-कः)
A cock.
f. (-का)
A lock of hair on the crown of the head.
E.
शिखण्ड a crest, &c. aff. ठक् or कन् in the fem. form.

m. (-ण्डी)
1 A peacock.
2 A peacock's tail.
3 A cock.
4 An arrow.
5 A Ṛṣi, either of the seven represented by the stars of the greater bear: see चित्रशिखण्डिन्.
6 The son of DRUPADA, by metamorphosis: see below.
f. (-नी)
1 A kind of jasmine, (J. auriculatum.)
2 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.)
3 The daughter of DRUPADA, afterwards changed to a male.
E.
शिखण्ड a crest, and इनि poss. aff.

mn. (-रः-रं)
1 The peak or summit of a mountain.
2 The top of a tree.
3 Point, end, top in general.
4

Horripilation.
5

The armpit.
6 A piece of a ruby or a gem, described as of the colour of the ripe pomegranate seed or a bright red.
7 The edge or point of a sword.
f. (-रा)
A plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
शिखा a crest, and रच् poss. aff., and the vowel made short.

f. (-नी)
DURGĀ.
E.
शिस्वर the peak, (of the Himālaya.) and वासिनी abiding.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Crested, peaked, pointed.
m. (-री)
1 A mountain.
2 A tree.
3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
4 A strong-hold, a hill-fort.
5 The lapwing.
f. (-रिणी)
1 A form of metre, a species of the class Atyaṣṭi or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each.
2 A dish of curds and sugar with spices.
3 An excellent woman.
4 Arabian jasmine.
5 A line of hair extending across the navel.
E.
शिस्वर a point or peak, and इनि aff.

m. (-तः)
A plant, commonly Kukurmurā.

m. (-रुः)
A candlestick or lampstand.
E.
शिखा flame, and तरु a tree.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Crested, pointed.
2 Having a top knot.
m. (-रः)
1 A peacock.
2 A Jaina deified saint.
E.
शिखा a crest, and धर who has.

m. (-रः)
A peacock.
E.
शिखा a crest, and धार who has.

n. (-लं)
A carrot, a turnip, or any root with a tuft of leaves growing from it.
E.
शिखा a crest, and मूल a root.

m. (-वान्)
A name of AGNI or fire.
2 The personified descending node.
3 A lamp.
f. (-वती)
A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
शिखा a crest, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-रः)
The jack fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Crested, pointed.
m. (-लः)
A peacock.
f. (-ला)
A flower, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
शिखा a crest, and वलच् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
The stand of lamp.
E.
शिखा flame, and वृक्ष a tree.

f. (-द्धिः)
Usurious interest payable daily. शिक्षा a tuft of hair, and वृद्धि interest; growing constantly.

n. (-वं)
Blue vitriol.
E.
शिखि for शिखिन् a peacock, ग्रीवा the neck, अच् added, being of the same colour.

Smoke.
2

The deity KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
शिखि a peacock, or fire, and ध्वज an emblem.

Crested.
2

Having a lock of hair on the top of the head.
m. (-खी)
1

Fire.
2

A peacock.
3 A bull.
4 An arrow.
5 A tree.
6 A cock.
7 KETU, the personified descending node.
8 A horse.
9 A mountain.
10 A

Brahman.
11

A lamp.
12 A religious mendicant.
E.
शिखा a crest, and इनि aff.

n. (-च्छं)
A peacock's tail.
E.
शिखि a peacock, and पुच्छ a tail.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Tapia cratæva.)
E.
शिखि a peacock, and मण्डल district.

m. (-कः)
A pumpkin gourd.
E.
शिखि a peacock, and वर्द्धक increasing.

m. (-नः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
शिखि a peacock, and वाहन a vehicle, the deity being mounted on this bird.

Flame.
2

A peacock's crest.
E.
शिखिन्, and शिखा a crest, &c.

n. (-रं)
A peacock's crest.
E.
शिखिन्, and शेखर a crest.
